name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, forced US LongFast region default for this public T-Deck build, GPS/compass refresh fixes, map/cache status, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, SD message journal support, SD prepare/reset tools, SD setup detection/progress readouts, SD-card notice controls, SD ringtone folder support, screen correction tools, serial recovery, a boot progress bar, the Modern Field on-device theme/layout, a public on-device health panel, an app-only Wi-Fi update menu, and home-screen LoRa status label fixes.

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, ringtone storage, logs, and prepare/reset setup; USB mass storage is disabled in this public build to keep serial stable.

build.status: Clean PlatformIO build completed successfully. This public build uses zdeck13 / 0.2.12-public naming, keeps the prior Z-Deck public stack, preserves the compiled US LoRa region default, keeps the SD setup detection/progress fixes and Modern Field layout, keeps app-only Wi-Fi updates, and fixes the T-Deck home signal row so the RX status keeps a full row slot.

publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
